summary: Harness V1.1 verification and explicit review
description: Local maintenance task, not a Jira issue. Replace demonstration role passes with structured readiness checks, actual build/test commands and explicit review.
acceptance_criteria: Incomplete ticket plans and workflow mismatches are rejected.
Build/test failure or timeout blocks completion; fixed checks can be rerun.
Approval requires reviewer notes, both checklist declarations and the latest unchanged snapshot.
Commands, outputs, timestamps and exit codes are saved per ticket and run.
scope: HarnessPractice local workflow and project verification adapters
implementation_steps: Introduce structured plan and project command configuration.
Implement check execution and snapshot-bound review.
Add regression tests and migration instructions.
